role: red-team (3 parallel agents: concurrency/data-integrity, edge-cases/regression, fleet/security/canon)
mechanism: Agent tool, subagent_type=red-team, 3 parallel read-only design attacks on the plan

redTeamFindings.summary: saveConfigAndSnapshot/writeSnapshot run inside the session window → arbiter.json + .arbiter-generated.json get recorded as manifest keys (poison).
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A1: session window brackets the registry run ONLY; endGenerationSession + persist BEFORE saveConfigAndSnapshot/runPlugins. Test asserts arbiter.json/.arbiter-generated.json never appear as manifest keys.

redTeamFindings.summary: Module-global session leaks across in-process commands via process.exit / throw paths → cross-test/batch contamination (wrong targetDir/prevHashes).
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A3: wrap the ENTIRE orchestrator body in try/finally(endGenerationSession); beginGenerationSession defensively resets. Test: a leaked session from command 1 cannot affect command 2.

redTeamFindings.summary: Selective update only seeds baselines for impacted generators → non-impacted skipIfExists files stay unprovenanced forever; diff (full) vs update (subset) drift → diff lies (the CANON-02 bug #1328 targets).
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A4: update runs the FULL registry (real), matching diff (full dryRun) → #1077 parity restored + full baseline coverage every run. The motivating template-fix case already took the full path; the selective config-subset write optimization is dropped for the manifest era.

redTeamFindings.summary: Hash recorded BEFORE atomicWrite → a throwing write (ENOSPC/EACCES) leaves a phantom hash for content never persisted → permanent false 'user-modified, fix withheld' on arbiter's own file.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A2: record newHashes[rel]=sha256(content) only AFTER the write/skip side-effect succeeds (atomicWrite throws propagate → no record). Single record point on the success path, covering created/replaced/skipped/dry-run.

redTeamFindings.summary: Corrupt/unparseable committed manifest (merge conflict) silently coerced to empty → every pristine file → skip+warn → fix withheld fleet-wide while exiting 0 (re-introduces #1328).
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A5: loadGeneratedManifest distinguishes missing (→empty, legit first run) from present-but-unparseable (→ throw, exit 2, INV-53 ERROR, fail-closed per INV-96).

redTeamFindings.summary: created-file early-return in writeFile (if dryRun||created) can skip hash recording → init first-run files never enter manifest → all skipIfExists permanently unprovenanced.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A2: hash recording is a single success-path statement reached by ALL actions incl. created; TDD unit asserts a created file's key is present in endGenerationSession().

redTeamFindings.summary: Plugin + skill writes (init) + doctor writeSnapshot are OUTSIDE the registry session → plugin skipIfExists files created but unhashed → future fix withheld; manifest non-determinism across commands.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A6: INV-122/AC scoped explicitly to REGISTRY-emitted skipIfExists files; plugin/skill/doctor writes stay legacy (out-of-session), documented. Session brackets only the registry run (consistent with A1).

redTeamFindings.summary: Two disk reads (contentEquals + new sha256(disk)) → TOCTOU + possible self-contradiction (equality read vs hash read see different bytes).
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A8: read disk bytes ONCE in resolveWriteAction; derive both ===content and sha256 from the same buffer.

redTeamFindings.summary: Windows path.relative yields backslash keys → key mismatch vs posix-committed manifest → every file never-pristine on Win/WSL-mixed fleets.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A7: posix-normalize relpath at BOTH the record site (fs.ts) and the manifest module; assert no '..'/absolute key → skip+warn, never crash. TDD unit with backslash input.

redTeamFindings.summary: doctor repair-state re-derives the snapshot but cannot re-derive the manifest → after repair the two sidecars disagree; command contract is a partial lie.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A9: repair-state prints a warning that the manifest is not re-derivable from config and to re-run `arbiter update` if drift is suspected. Documented; no new subcommand.

redTeamFindings.summary: CANON-09 parity: check-catalog-agents-parity.mjs requires byte-exact title match and does NOT join concatenated ('a'+'b') catalog titles → a multi-segment INV-122 title fails the L1 gate.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A10: INV-122 title is a SINGLE-line quoted string; the AGENTS.md **INV-122:** line reproduces it byte-for-byte (INV-120 long-title precedent).

redTeamFindings.summary: Manifest has no checksum/signature; a forged manifest can withhold a fix or overwrite a user edit.
redTeamFindings.resolution: Amendment A11 (accept-the-risk, documented): NO checksum — harm is bounded to skip-or-overwrite of two known canonical renders, both recoverable via git (the manifest is committed) + `diff` (compares content, not the manifest). Threat-model paragraph added to the doc. Orphan hashes from disabled generators are benign (disk-hash≠stored-hash preserves user edits) — no pruning.

disposition: All HIGH/MEDIUM findings merged into the plan as binding amendments A1-A11 (see plan §Red-team amendments). No CRITICAL → no red-team-rework needed; plan adapted in-place per /ship red-team-review protocol.
